svg.title: The anatomy of a unit
svg.desc: The vNorm Shrink unit's manifest, abridged, beside the strip a host draws from it: the title, the target and its layer knob, two knobs, the large knob for its fader parameter, and the power light and activity meter that the host gives every strip. Generated by tools/build_site.py.
svg.text: THE STRIP ON A HOST'S DESK
site, targets → the target and its layer
knobs → knobs, two to a row
fader → the large knob, the main control
checked against what the host offers
the line a host adds to a chain
returns the edit the host hooks in
power light, from the host: on, or bypassed
